svg.title: The Next Evolution of Prisma ORM
svg.desc: A lineage of three Prisma ORM generations drawn as plates, the newest stepped up and outlined in prism cyan: Prisma 6 shipped Rust native binaries, Prisma 7 rewrote the query system, Prisma 8 is rebuilt in TypeScript and extensible by default. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism cyan accent.
